caption:
The video captures two white ceramic bowls decorated with purple and pink floral rims resting on a wooden surface beside a window. The nearer bowl contains a large glossy translucent mass with an angular upper crest, while the farther bowl holds a similar pale solid. A greenish cast falls across the left edge in view, and the bowls stay largely in place relative to the camera. The nearer mass is glossy, reflective, and faceted.

Over time, the upper-left corner of the foreground mass loses its sharp edge and rounds downward. The solid slumps into a lower, smoother form, and a wet sheen becomes more apparent across the lower interior of the bowl. The background mass shows only slight deformation, remaining largely in place.

The change is not a shift of the bowls or the masses across the scene, but a deformation inside each bowl. The foreground solid continues to soften its contours, with the angular crest becoming part of a rounded surface. The farther pale form similarly adjusts without leaving its dish.
relations: Foreground mass softening causes its angular upper-left crest to round and slump downward.
Deformation of the foreground mass increases the apparent wet sheen across the lower interior of its bowl.
Background pale solid slight deformation persists while remaining largely in place within its dish.
Both floral-rimmed ceramic bowls maintain their positions relative to the camera and wooden surface.
